Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class KristenHttpServerEventAdapter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.KristenHttpServerEventAdapter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    KristenHttpServerEventHandler
    public class KristenHttpServerEventAdapter
extends Object
implements KristenHttpServerEventHandler
    Provides an empty implementation of KristenHttpServerEventHandler.

    Applications may extend this class and override only the HTTP server event methods they are interested in.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    KristenHttpServerEventHandler, KristenHttpServer
